title: The Philippines' big offshoring industry is growing despite AI
summary: The article examines how the Philippines' business process outsourcing (BPO) industry continues to expand despite widespread concerns that AI and automation will disrupt offshoring jobs. It explores the industry's resilience, adaptation strategies, and the evolving nature of outsourced work in the AI era.
problem_solved: Explains why the Philippines' BPO sector maintains growth momentum despite AI threats to traditional outsourcing roles.
why_valuable: Provides critical insights for businesses and policymakers on how labor markets in developing economies can adapt and thrive amid AI disruption.
